scope: Double Box trajectory selection and normal simulator responsive UI

definition.shower: 4x travels in a lateral Shower arc to the opposite hand; 4 returns to a vertical column.
definition.vertical: 4 and 4x are spatially vertical; for 4x the opposite hand moves under the ball to catch.
definition.independentControl: Four 2x selections remain unchanged when switching the high-ball trajectory.

automated.trajectoryCheck: Both variants, mirrored and unmirrored, preserve their intended high-flight endpoints after preparation for playback. Vertical flights have equal start/end X and Z; Shower 4x changes X and catching hand. Playback accepts each cycle and maximum grip error remains below 0.012.

browser.environment: Local in-app browser viewport checks, not physical phone testing
normal: Preview and controls occupy separate space; playback controls stay at the bottom.
No horizontal overflow at 320x568; scrolling control area is 153px high.
Collapsed panel can be reopened after switching to landscape.
Prop and camera selection, preset 51, typed siteswap 3, and pause/resume work.
Space on the preset summary opens/closes it without toggling playback.
ui=0&bg=transparent hides the panel and retains a transparent 390x844 stage.
Box Simulator navigation opens sync-compose.html in basic mode.
double: Selecting the vertical card updates its pressed state and all four per-set high-throw descriptions.
The mixed five-block route generates and plays with 13 requested sets and 2 handover sets.
Reload restores the vertical variant and the four passes: normal, shuffle, lateral-reverse, inverted.
The composer remains within the 390px viewport.

motionChanges: None; trajectory variants already existed. This change exposes their distinction, updates naming, and adds regression coverage.
